title: Dram Reacts To Drake Name Dropping Him on 'Back Outside Boyz' Off 'Her Loss'
htmlContent:
DRAM is one of Drake's lyrical hits on his new "Her Loss" collaborative album with 21 Savage.

"But he sees the sniping as a blessing in disguise."

The track "BackOutsideBoyz" features Drake rapping, "Tried to bring the drama to me, he doesn't know how we cha-cha slide…" -- choose the crust on the "Cha Cha" vs. the "Bling Hotline" plundering controversy of many years ago.

DRAM recently told TMZ, "After being escorted outside, DRAM says "15 of Drake's bodyguards" were ready to beat him up, and that's what they did! As he ended up seeing pink hearts, yellow moons and green shamrock … DRAM feels fortunate that an artist of Drake's stature is clearly under threat from him."

DRAM would later says he's in love mode, and he doesn't pretend to be a fighter, but he's still gonna need this 1-on-1 fight with Drake to completely bury the hatchet.
